title: Numbers Bible Quiz - Chapter 9
description: Ten questions on Numbers 9: the Passover in the wilderness of Sinai, the second Passover, and the cloud that guided Israel's travels.

questions.text: On which day of the first month did Israel keep the Passover in the wilderness of Sinai?
questions.explanation: They kept the Passover in the first month, on the fourteenth day of the month at evening, in the wilderness of Sinai.

answers.text: The first day
The tenth day
The fourteenth day
The twenty-first day

questions.text: Why could certain men not keep the Passover on that day?
questions.explanation: Certain men were unclean because of the dead body of a man, so they could not keep the Passover on that day.

answers.text: They were on a journey far from the camp
They were unclean because of a dead body
They were foreigners living among Israel
They had no lamb for their household

questions.text: What did Moses say to the men who could not keep the Passover?
questions.explanation: Moses answered them, "Wait, that I may hear what Yahweh will command concerning you."

answers.text: "Wait, that I may hear what Yahweh will command"
"Go and keep it in the next year instead"
"Bring a sin offering to Aaron the priest"
"You must leave the camp for seven days"

questions.text: When were those who were unclean or far away on a journey to keep the Passover?
questions.explanation: They were to keep it in the second month, on the fourteenth day at evening.

answers.text: In the seventh month, on the tenth day
In the first month of the next year
On the first day of the third month
In the second month, on the fourteenth day

questions.text: With what were they to eat the Passover?
questions.explanation: They were to eat it with unleavened bread and bitter herbs.

answers.text: Wine and cakes of fine flour
Unleavened bread and bitter herbs
Honey and roasted grain
Olive oil and salt

questions.text: What would happen to a clean man, not on a journey, who failed to keep the Passover?
questions.explanation: That soul would be cut off from his people and bear his sin, because he did not offer Yahweh's offering in its appointed season.

answers.text: He would be cut off from his people
He would pay a fifth part to the priest
He would keep it in the second month
He would be sent outside the camp for seven days

questions.text: What did Yahweh say about a foreigner who wanted to keep the Passover?
questions.explanation: A foreigner who desired to keep the Passover was to do so according to its statute; there was one statute for the foreigner and the native-born.

answers.text: He could never keep it
He had to wait until the second month
He had to keep it outside the camp
He could keep it under the same statute

questions.text: What was the appearance over the tabernacle at night?
questions.explanation: The cloud covered the tabernacle, and at evening it was over the tabernacle like the appearance of fire until morning.

answers.text: The appearance of fire
A rainbow
A shining star
A flash of lightning

questions.text: What did the children of Israel do whenever the cloud was taken up from over the Tent?
questions.explanation: Whenever the cloud was taken up from over the Tent, the children of Israel traveled, and where it remained, they encamped.

answers.text: They gathered for a feast
They offered a burnt offering
They traveled
They counted the people

questions.text: What did Israel do when the cloud stayed on the tabernacle for days, a month or a year?
questions.explanation: Whether it was two days, a month or a year that the cloud stayed on the tabernacle, the children of Israel remained encamped and did not travel.

answers.text: They sent spies ahead
They remained encamped
They moved the tabernacle
They asked Moses to pray
